title: Esther taken to Ahasuerus
summary: Esther is taken to king Ahasuerus (Esth 2:16). Jones identifies that king with Darius I.
description: Esther is taken to king Ahasuerus (Esth 2:16). Jones identifies that king with Darius I. The year is the Appendix F figure, stored as printed.

sorting_basis.note: Tier 3: Ussher-Jones (Floyd Nolen Jones): 515 BC (no higher-tier year available).

chronologies.citation: Jones, The Chronology of the Old Testament: A Return to the Basics, 23rd ed. (Master Books, 2026), Appendix F, printed p. 280 (PDF p. 315)
chronologies.note: Jones’s Ahasuerus is Darius I, linked on darius-i. Esther has no person record.
